scripts.build: pnpm build:anchor && pnpm build:idl && pnpm allow-read-write
scripts.build:anchor: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'bash scripts/sbf-build.sh anchor build --ignore-keys --no-idl --tools-version v1.57 --arch v3' anchor
scripts.build:anchor:heap-profiling: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'bash scripts/sbf-build.sh anchor build --ignore-keys --no-idl --tools-version v1.57 --arch v3 -p onesig -- --features heap-profiling --sbf-out-dir ./target' anchor
scripts.build:anchor:native: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --docker-platform native --script 'bash scripts/sbf-build.sh anchor build --ignore-keys --no-idl --tools-version v1.57 --arch v3' anchor
scripts.build:idl: pnpm resolve-dependencies && mkdir -p build && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'anchor idl build -p onesig -o build/onesig.json && add_address_to_idl.py --idl-dir build' anchor
scripts.build:idl:native: pnpm resolve-dependencies && mkdir -p build && pnpm exec lz-tool --docker-platform native --script 'anchor idl build -p onesig -o build/onesig.json && add_address_to_idl.py --idl-dir build' anchor
scripts.build:native: pnpm build:anchor:native && pnpm build:idl:native && pnpm allow-read-write
scripts.format:check: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo +nightly-2025-06-01 fmt --all --check' anchor
scripts.format:rs: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo +nightly-2025-06-01 fmt --all' anchor
scripts.lint: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint:rs && pnpm lint:ts
scripts.lint:rs: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo clippy -- -D warnings' anchor
scripts.test:rs: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo test --package onesig -- tests --nocapture' anchor
